objective: Let a local product owner record one immutable human-confirmed Completed Fix for a Review Delivery while keeping merge and hosted verification outside SignalDesk and Elder authority.
scope: Add the Completed Fixes bounded context and delivery-to-completion workflow.
Create at most one immutable Completed Fix for an existing Review Delivery in a locked PostgreSQL transaction.
Persist the merged commit SHA, completion summary, unverified local operator label, and server time.
Add POST /api/v1/review-deliveries/{reviewDeliveryId}/completed-fix and an additive completedFix Signal-detail projection.
Expose the full Feedback-to-Completion trace through the local product interface without claiming hosted-provider verification.
Add product-owned machine-readable lifecycle context that describes evidence and retained authority without granting access.
Analyze Elder consumption after product verification and correct only one reproduced generalized blocker.
non_goals: GitHub API verification, PR synchronization, merge execution, deployment, release, or customer communication.
Editing, deletion, multiple completion attempts, authentication, verified identity, tenancy, or public hosting.
L2 or L3 promotion, constitutional changes, SD-006, or changes to the qualification observation threshold.
evidence_plan: Foundation: validate ADR, contract, work item, lifecycle context, Prisma schema, migration, source layout, boundaries, types, lint, and route surface.
Component: prove explicit external-merge confirmation, commit validation, text bounds, content checks, and server identity/time binding.
Integration: prove source delivery locking, one immutable completion per delivery, exact lineage, concurrency rejection, and PostgreSQL constraints.
Workflow: create the complete feedback-to-completed-fix trace through the local UI and observe persistence after reload at desktop and mobile widths.
Stress: prove concurrent completion has one winner, malformed and missing sources fail closed, database outage recovers with lineage intact, and completion content is absent from logs.
Factory: inspect product-context consumption, reproduce any blocker, make no more than one generalized Elder correction, and preserve authority separation.
